summary: Lando Norris won the Dutch Grand Prix from pole position, 11.5s ahead of Kimi Antonelli, with George Russell completing the podium.
Fernando Alonso made the biggest climb, from P18 to P9.
Gabriel Bortoleto had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag and 2 virtual safety cars.
The stewards penalised LIN (drive through penalty), COL (drive through penalty), COL (10 second time penalty), LAW (10 second time penalty) and SAI (10 second time penalty).
There were 65 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 59 points over George Russell.
